attempts.summary: Published node4's HTTP service (port 8080) on node2's transit-side address 10.10.12.2:80 via OPNsense port-forward, and gave node3 (on lan-a) a static route through node1 to reach that address. Verified node3 reaches the service only via node2's address, never node4 directly. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, each with confirmed changed boot identity and confirmed post-restart recovery of configuration, service, and connectivity.
